parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Surrey · Whalley and City Centre

Cedar Hills is an MLS® area in North Surrey, between about 96 and 106 Avenue, west of about 132 Street, where Whalley begins. It meets Royal Heights along Scott Road (120 Street). Cedar Hills Elementary on 98 Avenue is named for it, and Robson Park sits on 100 Avenue. The City lists the parks here under Whalley and City Centre.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 13, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate since 2015. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Surrey and Surrey Schools.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

Cedar Hills is an MLS® area name in Surrey. On the MLS® map it runs from about 96 Avenue north to about 106 Avenue, with its east edge around 132 Street. South of 96 Avenue is Queen Mary Park, and Whalley is to the east and north. It meets Royal Heights along Scott Road (120 Street). These edges are approximate and are not an official City boundary, so ask me if a specific address is in it.
